lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Front down-flange along the +x edge, about 90 deg. In my 25/50/75% perpendicular sections the label sits on the outer-arc vertex, 0.03-0.16 mm from the nearest outer-skin point. Apex-tube occupancy runs t=-1 to 377 mm; the line covers 0 to 372.9.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Tall tab at the -y front corner, 90.4 deg, planar tab with no lean. The label is on the outer apex in all 3 sections (0.10-0.24 mm). The arc runs from the tab edge to the corner relief, about 47 mm; the line is 44.7 mm.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Tall tab at the +y front corner, leaning inward. The label is on the outer apex in the 25/50/75% sections (0.10-0.19 mm). The arc runs from the tab edge to the semicircular relief, about 46 mm; the line is 42.4 mm. The extra ~12 deg of lean above it is the tail of this same fold, not a second bend: the outer-skin lean profile vs height goes 0 to -17 deg over z=4-10 mm, then -17 to -21 deg by z=20, with decaying curvature, no second curvature peak and no crease.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Short tab at the +y back corner, 90 deg. Lines were fitted to the inner skin, but the label lies on the outer arc vertex in all 3 sections (0.26-0.33 mm). The arc is about 49 mm; the line is 47.1 mm.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Short tab at the -y back corner, leaning outward, 65.6 deg bend. The label is on the broad outer arc in the sections: outward height matches the outermost point within 0.2 mm, nearest cloud point 0.17-0.34 mm. The arc is about 50 mm; the line is 47.4 mm. The base tail next to it peaks at ~7 deg slope and falls to 0 by ~30 mm, total under 10 deg, no crease, so it is not a bend.
